title: Module metadata
description: Hand-written metadata that sits next to a module's main.bicep or main.tf. Cloud- and tool-agnostic so the same shape describes every module in the repo, whatever cloud or IaC tool it targets.

id.description: Permanent ID: <cloud>:<tool>:<kind>/<provider-group>/<module>. Matches the folder path, e.g. azure:bicep:res/storage/storage-account for Azure/Bicep/res/storage/storage-account.

summary.description: One or two sentences in the language a user would ask for it in.

source.description: Upstream module reference, e.g. br/public:avm/res/storage/storage-account or Azure/avm-res-storage-storageaccount/azurerm.

pairsWith.description: IDs of modules commonly deployed together, in the same <cloud>:<tool>:... form as id.
